# Owned finite interface qualification

These messages, profiles and expected outcomes were independently authored for
four fictional interfaces and then instantiated at each of the seven declared
wire versions. No message is generated by the profile evaluator or extracted
from upstream metadata. The checked-in wire files are the test inputs, and the
expectation files state the positive/negative answers independently.

Identity/visit declares A01 → A08 → A03 over patient and visit namespaces;
scheduling declares S12 → S13 → S15 over placer and filler appointment identities;
order declares NW → XO → CA; repeated result subjects declare P → F → C within
their own ORC/OBR group. These are reviewed fixture expectations, not universal
clinical rules or complete base-standard event coverage. ZTM is an expressly
local timestamp extension: TS through 2.5.1 and DTM in the later fixture cells.

Every cell tests success, a skipped transition, the same capture gap with
incomplete capture, a different namespace, malformed grouping and an invalid
calendar date. The machine-readable `docs/profile-semantic-fixtures.json` binds
every byte and expectation to its test. The upstream packs remain a separate,
unqualified, withheld matrix; these fixtures do not make them distributable.
